description: NaMg₄La₅(WO₆)₄ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.67 Å. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-28°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.15 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-30°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.15 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-29°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.12 Å. There are four inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-3.08 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.88 Å. In the third La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.71 Å. In the fourth La site, La is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.92 Å. There are three inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-30°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.06 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-29°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.08 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-28°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.07 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two La, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one La, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, three La, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Mg, three La, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, two La, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Mg, two La, and one W atom to form distorted edge-sharing OLa₂MgW trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two La, and one W atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, two La, and one W atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one La, and one W atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one La, and one W atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two La, and one W atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Mg, three La, and one W atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one La, and one W atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one W atom.
